title: ci: remove registry.k8s.io dependency from tests
body:
Today `registry.k8s.io` registry seem to have issues, at least we seem to get weird 400 errors during pulls. We have no control over chaning content on that registry and since that one has caused problems in the past I would recommend replacing that with our known good testimages under quay.io/libpod somehwere.

comments.body: Makes sense. (Note https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1116#pullrequestreview-5019802172 … the “obvious” replacement might be quite a bit larger.)

This has been fixed. podman/cri-o was sending Authorization Header, which caused errors with our backend. This behaviour doesn't exist with containerd/go-containerregistry projects(this is what we use to test our registry changes).
